title: Active Learning of Conditional Generative Models via the Transport Neural Tangent Kernel
abstract: arXiv:2610.35652v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many high-throughput scientific experiments produce distributional outputs, requiring conditional generative models to interpret the data, and to predict outcomes at new inputs. Acquiring experimental data at new conditions (e.g., for a new antigen or a new cell type) is often expensive, motivating the need for automated experimental design methods. However, existing active learning frameworks are limited as they assume scalar or vector-valued outputs. We first show that the Wasserstein test risk of a conditional generative task decomposes into a mean term and a shape term, demonstrating why mean-based active learning is blind to distributional shape. To capture both, we propose the transport Neural Tangent Kernel (tNTK), a tractable kernel that measures how sensitive a generative model's predicted distribution is with respect to its parameters. The tNTK recovers the standard NTK in the deterministic limit and upper-bounds the posterior

translated_title: 基于输运神经正切核的条件生成模型主动学习
translated_abstract: 许多高通量科学实验会产生分布型的输出，需要条件生成模型来解释数据并预测新输入下的结果。在新的实验条件下（例如针对新抗原或新细胞类型）获取实验数据往往成本高昂，这促使了对自动化实验设计方法的需求。然而，现有的主动学习框架存在局限，因为它们假设输出是标量或向量值的形式。我们首先证明了条件生成任务的Wasserstein测试风险可以分解为均值项和形状项，这解释了为什么基于均值的主动学习对分布的形状“视而不见”。为了同时捕捉两者，我们提出了输运神经正切核，这是一种易于计算的核函数，用于衡量生成模型预测的分布对其参数的敏感程度。tNTK在确定性极限下可恢复为标准的NTK，并对后验不确定性提供了上界……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出输运神经正切核，解决了现有主动学习无法感知分布形状的问题，使条件生成模型能够通过同时考量均值与形状的实验设计方法高效获取新条件下的实验数据。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the transport Neural Tangent Kernel (tNTK), which enables active learning for conditional generative models by capturing both the mean and shape of distributional outputs, overcoming the limitations of mean-based active learning in automated experimental design.
